values.description: The seed `receipt` template's `key`, auto-generated (nanoid) on first server startup and specific to this instance's SQLite file. Get the real value from Templates > List Templates, or: sqlite3 document_server.db "SELECT key, name FROM templates;" (adjust the path to the production DATABASE_URL).
The seed `sticker` template's `key` — same instance-specific caveat as `templateKey`, just for the `sticker` row instead of `receipt`.
A `documents.key` from a render you've already made on this instance (render something first, then Documents > List Documents). Used by Get Document/Reprint Document.
Shared secret sent as X-Internal-Api-Key on every internal-caller route (render, documents, templates/sync, template-data). Must match the server's INTERNAL_API_KEY.
A template's stable *name* (its .typ stem) — the identity template-data routes are scoped by. No nanoid here: names are the disk identity and never change per instance.
Caller-chosen name of a stored shared/static data blob within a template's namespace (e.g. 'shop', 'branding').
